description:
Add a Server to a Placement Group

Adds a Server to a Placement Group.

Server must be powered off for this command to succeed.

#### Operation specific errors

| Status | Code | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `422` | `server_not_stopped` | The action requires a stopped server |
| `422` | `already_in_placement_group` | The server is already part of a placement group |

placement_group.description: ID of Placement Group the Server should be added to.

wait.description: Poll the resulting action until success/error or timeout.

name: hcloud_server_add_to_placement_group_action
